sections.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Strength +2, Dexterity −2, Intelligence +2, Charisma −2. Base land speed 30 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft. in black and white. +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Shadow Affinity (Ex) gives +2 racial bonus to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot in darkness or shadowy illumination.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. Its penalty applies to attack rolls only.
+1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs and half-orcs. The bonus and the light penalty both apply if both conditions are present.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Orc. Favored class Wizard. Level adjustment +1.

sections.title: Original NPC · Maren Eldermere
lines: Seed vault keeper and generalist Wizard.
Motive. Find out who entered the seed vault before a delayed spring shipment is reopened.
Hook. Maren can study the damaged catches if the party keeps the room clear and brings the missing inventory board.
Sharakim seed vault keeper, Wizard 1 · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2. · Medium Humanoid (Human)

sections.title: Original NPC · Oswin Fenlock
lines: Motive. Find what keeps tripping the cistern gate before the next water draw.
Hook. Oswin can inspect the dark maintenance stair if the party keeps the main lever still.
Sharakim cistern inspector, Rogue 1 · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2. · Medium Humanoid (Human)
